tagData.title: headers
tagData.name: Headers
tagData.description: Headers and hero areas are a key part of web design. They represent the first thing a visitor sees on your page. This is why it is important to make sure that they are as attractive as possible. The hero area is the section of a webpage that has the most important information. It is usually positioned at the top of the website and can be found above or below the header. The hero area is usually used to promote a product or service that may not be on sale for everyone, but it will only be available to those who are able to see this area.
